verdict.rationale: Auth0 for AI Agents documents infrastructure specifically for autonomous background operation: CIBA lets agents request approval for sensitive actions asynchronously 'even when the user is not actively using the application,' and Token Vault lets agents call third-party APIs on a user's behalf without live user interaction. This supports building autonomous agentic workflows, but Auth0 itself is an auth/identity layer, not an automation-orchestration or scheduling product — there's no evidence of a built-in mechanism to 'set up' and run a background automation end-to-end (e.g., triggers, schedules, workflow builder). Missing for 10: a native automation/orchestration/scheduling capability beyond auth flows, and independent/hands-on evidence of an agent running autonomously end-to-end using these features.
